claim: Dal Pescatore street address is Via Runate 15, 46013 Canneto sull'Oglio (MN), in the hamlet of Runate.
quote: Dal Pescatore - Via Runate, 15, 46013 Canneto sull'Oglio MN, Italy

claim: Dal Pescatore has held three Michelin stars since 1996; Nadia Santini was the first Italian woman to hold three stars. The restaurant traces to the 1926 osteria opened by Antonio Santini, a fisherman on the Oglio.
quote: Three-starred since 1996 - a record in Italy, and Nadia Santini became the first Italian woman to hold that title.

claim: 9 Muse B&B is at Via Giordano Bruno 42A, Canneto sull'Oglio; an 18th-century farmhouse restoration with four muse-named rooms run personally by Caterina Vagliani; Dal Pescatore is about 3 km away.
quote: a skillful and careful restoration of an eighteenth-century farmhouse

claim: 9 Muse holds a 4.9/5 rating and #1 of 2 B&Bs in Canneto; standard-room rates run $128-144; round-trip transfer to Dal Pescatore is offered for €40, removing drink-driving concerns.
quote: $128 - $144 (Based on Average Rates for a Standard Room) ... transportation to nearby Ristorante dal Pescatore Santini for a fee of 40 euros for round-trip service

claim: A Tripadvisor reviewer reports co-host Alberto previously worked as a chef at Dal Pescatore.
quote: Alberto previously worked as a chef at Dal Pescatore and still works as a chef.

claim: Palazzo Quaranta is a restored historic palazzo at Largo Vittoria 12, Isola Dovarese, with 8 rooms, frescoed ceilings and walls, family-run with on-site restaurant; about 2.2 miles (~3.5 km) from Dal Pescatore.
quote: Beautifully painted ceilings and walls frescoes ... 8 rooms ... Approximately 2.2 miles (nearby fine dining destination)

claim: Dimora & Arte sits at Via Garibaldi 81 in Canneto's historic centre; a late-19th-c. manor with 3 rooms, antique furnishings and a 'vast collection of art literature'; 4.5/5 rating; ~1.8 mi from Dal Pescatore.
quote: elegant antique style and a vast collection of art literature ... 4.5 out of 5 stars ... approximately 1.8 miles

claim: Agriturismo L'Airone lies 1.58 km south of Dal Pescatore, in Castelfranco d'Oglio; nearest accommodation in the closest-properties index.
quote: Agriturismo L'Airone is located at S.C. per Isola Dovarese 2 - Castelfranco d'Oglio, 1.58 kilometers south

claim: Agriturismo L'Airone offers rustic rooms, on-site restaurant, free bike rental, horse stables and an in-room masseuse; described by reviewers as a quiet retreat ideal for a Dal Pescatore dinner.
quote: ideal for those who go to eat at the restaurant il Pescatore ... bike rental free and horse riding available

claim: Toson d'Oro is an elegant residence inside the walls of UNESCO Sabbioneta at Via dei Serviti 10, with three rooms (Giulia, Isabella, Suite Vespasiano) and the namesake nods to the Golden Fleece award given to Duke Vespasiano Gonzaga in 1585.
quote: within the walls of the historic center of Sabbioneta ... Room Giulia, Room Isabella, Suite Vespasiano

claim: Toson d'Oro is #2 of 6 B&Bs in Sabbioneta with a 5/5 Tripadvisor rating; Booking.com aggregates a 9.7 from recent guests.
quote: ranked #2 of 6 B&Bs/inns in Sabbioneta and rated 5 of 5 at Tripadvisor ... rated 9.7 by recent guests on Booking.com

claim: Mantua and Sabbioneta were inscribed jointly on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2008; Sabbioneta is the prototype of the planned Renaissance 'ideal city' built between 1556-1591 under Vespasiano Gonzaga.
quote: Mantua and Sabbioneta ... inscribed in 2008 ... Sabbioneta, founded by Vespasiano Gonzaga ... represents the implementation of the period's theories about planning the ideal city

claim: Sabbioneta to Canneto sull'Oglio is 25-26 km by road, ~26 min by car; a direct taxi runs €50-65 one-way (no direct public connection).
quote: The distance between Sabbioneta and Canneto sull'Oglio is 25 km ... Direct Taxi ... Duration: 26 minutes, Cost: €50-65

claim: Hotel Margot is in central Canneto sull'Oglio across from the historic Gonzaga Tower, 50 m from the railway station, with outdoor pool, indoor parking and panoramic lift.
quote: located in Canneto Sull'Oglio surrounded by green farms, across from the historic Gonzaga Tower ... newly built outdoor swimming pool

claim: Corte Mainolda is a historic Lombard courtyard farm at Via Mainolda 1, Sarginesco (Castellucchio, MN), now a residenza d'epoca and agriturismo; ~18-21 km from Canneto sull'Oglio.
quote: Corte Mainolda ... Residenza d'Epoca ... Sarginesco, Provincia di Mantova

claim: Locanda sul fiume is a riverside inn 1.6 km from Asola centre with a 8.8 couples rating, traditional Italian restaurant and rooms with garden or river views.
quote: charming inn situated in the tranquil countryside near Asola, just 1.6 km from the town center ... 8.8 for a two-person trip

claim: The Santini family curates a Relais & Châteaux 'Route du Bonheur' from the Po valley to the Veneto, signposting the higher-end stays one rung above Canneto's B&Bs (Albereta, etc.) in their gastronomic neighbourhood.
quote: A Relais Châteaux itinerary from the Po Valley to the Venetian countryside by the Santini family

claim: Agriturismo Rivieraoglio in Piadena is a renovated Lombard farmhouse in a 'converted convent' farm village, with free bikes and a 4/5 Tripadvisor rating; about 8-10 km from Canneto sull'Oglio.
quote: true Italian agriturismo in a quiet farm village with converted convent ... ranked #1 of 1 specialty lodging in Piadena and rated 4 of 5
